knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # for data wrangling and visualization
library(psych)      # for describe() and scoreItems()
library(janitor)    # for frequency and contingency tables
library(broom)      # for tidy t-test output
library(papaja)     # for APA style output
library(car)        # for leveneTest()
library(lsr)        # for cohensD()
library(BrailleR)   # for accessibility
GoBlind()
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 16))
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv('data/imundo_study2.csv') %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(RestudyContext = factor(RestudyContext, levels = c("Different", "Same")))
glimpse(df)
```

```{r}
describe(df) %>%
  knitr::kable() 
```

```{r}
df %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = ProportionRecalled)) +
    facet_wrap(~RestudyContext) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 9, color = "black", fill = "lightblue") +
    labs(x = "Proportion of Words Recalled", y = "Frequency") +
    theme_classic()
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(df %>% filter(RestudyContext == "Same") %>% pull(ProportionRecalled))
shapiro.test(df %>% filter(RestudyContext == "Different") %>% pull(ProportionRecalled))
```

```{r}
leveneTest(ProportionRecalled ~ RestudyContext, data = df) %>%
    tidy() %>%
    knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
res_ind_t <- t.test(ProportionRecalled ~ RestudyContext, 
                  data = df,
                  var.equal = TRUE,
                  alternative = "two.sided")
res_ind_t
```
